# Color combiners prebuilt into romfs:/shadercache by tools/switch/shader_bake.c, so the
# Switch build doesn't compile them at runtime. Format: src/pc/switch/shader_cache.h.
# Regenerate with tools/switch/gather_combiners.sh (it also merges combiners.txt files
# that the game writes to <user dir>/shadercache/ when it has to compile one).
